questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four alternatives, select the alternative which will improve the bracketed part of the sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'no improvement'.**

Data of seizure of tiger body parts reveal that of the 14 cases, ﬁve (was reported) inside their serves.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'were reported'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the subject is 'Data' and the verb for this is 'reveal' and it is a plural verb because the subject is plural.
 
• After the comma there is one more subject that is 'five' hence it is a plural noun so we need a plural verb for this also, it is written in the passive voice because the doer of the verb 'reported' is somebody else. 

**So the correct sentence is-** *Data of seizure of tiger body parts reveal that of the 14 cases, **five were reported **inside their serves.*

questions.question: Teachers ____________ the country require proper training
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Across'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• On looking at the above-given passage, we observe that it is based on evaluation of teaching method in the country involving ethics, human psychology, etc. in their practices. The given blank would be filled by a preposition. It shows that teaching method done in each part of the country. 
 
• Clearly, option 1 is not the answer.
 
• Now, find the uses of the following prepositions:-
 
 
• overextending directly upwards from; above on the top. 
 
• beyond - at or to the further side of.
 
• across - from one side to the other of (a place, area, etc.).
 
 
 
• Thus, option 4 i.e. **across **gives the most meaningful sense to the context. So, option 4 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

The debate

P : on allowing euthanasia to

Q : protect the dignity of patients in a

R : vegetative state has become a key question
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the fixed part, the noun is given that is a subject of the sentence hence after this we need a verb for this subject and it is has been given in part R but it cannot be the first part because this makes the sentence contextually incorrect.
 
• Hence, according to the context, the correct part is 'P' 
 
• In part P, the preposition 'to' is used after this we need to write a verb that is given in part Q.
 
• Hence, the correct sequence is** 'PQR' i.e.** ***The debate on allowing euthanasia to protect the dignity of patients in a vegetative state has become a key question.***

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

The Taj Mahal can be (1)/ called jewel (2)/ of the nation. (3)/ No error
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** '2' i.e. error lies in this part of the sentence.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**In part 2 of the sentence,** the usage of **'a' **before 'jewel' is missing. Hence, we need to use 'a jewel'

 
• According to grammar, Use 'a' and 'an' article with such proper nouns that are referred to as 'common nouns'
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Hitesh is a Hitler. (Hitler here acts as a common noun.)
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, 'jewel of the nation' acts as a common noun hence use the indefinite article.

**So the correct sentence is-** *The Taj Mahal can be called **a jewel **of the nation. *
